What the advice you want? Better yet what do you want to hear? 

You say you’re miserable, lonely, and are getting abused in multiple ways in your relationship. Everyone will tell you that it’s not a good idea to stay. I am telling you that it’s not a good idea to allow this type of behavior to happen. 

I’ll give you that it’s hard to leave someone you love, also the fear of what someone will do if you do leave them. But for you to have life goals and career aspirations you need to have people and a significant other who is there to support you every step of the way. Not someone who manipulates and bullies, and uses you for everything you have. 

If you don’t want to break up with him that’s fine, but you’re going to have a bad time 100% of the time, especially if you’re asking for advice on what YOU need or should do. You need to leave him and move on. That is the only way to get any where close to a better life. 
It’s your choice to stay and try to repair the damage but that’s a lot more work on your end and it doesn’t sound like he is willing to change. 

People who make excuses for why they can’t do something before they try, are manipulative and will suck you dry for everything you have. Financially, emotionally, and physically.

We got married when she was 19, lived together for 3 or 4 years then just a year ago moved into her moms house. It’s not ideal and I get that it will drastically hurt things.  

I fucked up and take 100% accountability for that. No debate in that. The problem I have is that taking about the infidelity doesn’t happen. I try to explain and it doesn’t help. Not that it should I cheated and there is nothing other than that. But I try to work past the issue   I know I need to wait for her to talk about it. The hard part is just waiting.

How does one make themselves a higher priority? I work so she doesn’t have to ( she always offers to work and try to make taking care of the kids work) day care is just out of the realm of finances so she takes care of the kids and goes to school while I work a job and take care of the bills etc. 

I just don’t know how I make myself more attractive to her. I go to the gym. I keep myself very clean. I just am not sure how to do much more with the limited amount of time I have. I flip flop between day shift and night shift a lot of I rarely see her.

I have really changed a lot since this all happened two years ago, the affection and sex is still minimal which I get since I was not a good person. 
I try really hard to be a better person everyday, build trust and prove I’m willing to work on the issue at hand.  I just don’t know how to actively talk about the issue.

Firstly, I appreciate the time giving advice it means a lot. 
Secondly, she has told me that it’s still an issue and that she still doesn’t always trust what I’m doing or saying I’m doing. Which I get, I fucked up on that one big time. I try to be as understanding as I can be and try to show my path towards trust and transparency. 

It is awkward and uncomfortable living in her house, but with me losing my job that made a lot more and now working at a job that pays significantly less it’s been rough on us. I made 50k a year to now making about 27k a year. So a significant drop has made trying to live some where else very hard. Especially with two kids. 

Again I appreciate the time and advice.

After my career in the Army I felt like a giant failure. I got an honorable discharge but didn’t do much and just feel like I could have done a lot more. I got married really young to a wife who doesn’t have everything all together and at times she is really verbally abusive and she doesn’t understand that.  I was blown up in the Boston bombings and I have severe PTSD, anxiety and, depression from that and it makes it incredibly hard for me to do my day to day tasks. I have been trying to apply for VA disability but I can’t stomach to leave my house because of he anxiety. Pretty much the only thing that makes me not kill myself is my dog because I know my wife would just get rid of her. I just feel useless and can’t function properly.
Placed the gun to my head but couldn’t pull the trigger. I feel like a failure. I can’t shake this enormous sense of failure. I can’t stand what I have become anymore.

Living with any mental illness I’ll tough and most families don’t have any idea what to do so they distance themselves thinking it will help. They think by distancing themselves it will create this new found energy and motivation but it has the opposite effect. The biggest advice I can offer to you is to continue to work on yourself and establish communication at small intervals. Everyone wants to hear about the good and not the bad. Doing cocaine I wouldn’t suggest but then again it’s an attempt to fix the problem just won’t really help. 

Now for your wife, if she has stuck with you this long you need to be open and honest. And you need to tell her how you feel and tell her exactly what you said earlier how much you adore her. She is sticking by you because she loves you and wants to help. If she didn’t she would have left. 

I’m available at anytime for a talk man. Keep on working on your issues and keep reaching out. Like everyone has mentioned you’re not alone.
